offence_note: Criminal negligence causing bodily harm and aggravated assault (HIV transmission)
sentence_quote: I would set aside the sentence of two years imprisonment imposed at trial and substitute a sentence of two years less one day.
note: Trial judge also gave one year credit for strict bail conditions; reduced by one day for immigration reasons.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to life imprisonment for the second degree murder of Andra Ghiorghita. I have determined that the principles of sentencing will be met by a period of parole ineligibility of 10 years.
note: Sentencing for parole ineligibility only; life mandatory.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would, therefore, substitute a sentence of time served, inclusive of 32 days’ pre-sentence credit, for a total of 347 days’ incarceration, followed by a conditional sentence of 382 days.
note: Original 2 years less 32 days credit; varied to time served plus conditional sentence; global 2 years less a day; house arrest.

offence_note: Sexual assault causing bodily harm, unlawful confinement, uttering death threat
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal against sentence and quash the order declaring the appellant a dangerous offender as well as the indeterminate sentence. I would order a new dangerous offender hearing.
note: New dangerous offender hearing ordered; conviction appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Threatening death, breach of probation, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: We grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal and vary the sentence to time served.
note: Four years reduced to time served, about 35 months already served.

offence_note: Sexual assault of wife's niece, abuse of trust
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a sentence of three years’ imprisonment.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted but dismissed.

offence_note: Four counts of indecent assault by physician
sentence_quote: The appeals against conviction and sentence are dismissed as abated appeals without any adjudication of their merits.
note: Appellant died; appeal abated. Trial sentence was two years imprisonment.

offence_note: Break and enter with theft; breach of probation and recognizance
sentence_quote: He was given ten months credit for eight and a half months of pre-trial custody, resulting in a global sentence of 44 months.
note: 3.5 years plus 1 year consecutive computed as 54 months before credit.

offence_note: Theft of chocolate bars; theft of motor vehicle (youth)
sentence_quote: 12 months for auto theft is a high sentence for a 14 year old but it is not, in my view, excessive
note: Youth 14; 12 months open custody concurrent plus 12 months probation; appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Six counts of sexual misconduct against two step-granddaughters
